finding: BR-099 counts only the strict names backlog/ST-NNNN.md and docs/findings/<PREFIX>-NNNN.md and a heading ## T-NNNN. BR-100 counts any name that starts with a prefix, a hyphen, and digits, such as SPEC-011-title.md. By BR-100, the ADR files docs/adr/NNNN-*.md start with digits and do not count. The todo headings of this project carry a title, such as ## T-0020 — A claim can still open a credential dialog. Let BR-099 name the three locations and BR-100 the match for backlog and findings, state that ADR files match NNNN-*.md, and state that a todo heading counts when it starts with ## T-NNNN. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: The Scenarios of CIF-05 and CIF-06 show the intended match, so an implementer can act (no to fails_purpose); a reader must combine two rules that each read as the whole match (raises_cost).
